240-4050-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-1978-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.

643-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
643-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

4460-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3286-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
3286-4687-5296.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5042-5567-8095--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5042-5567-8095--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

560-4550-5147-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5147-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Repeat.

215-1753-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-1753-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1753-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7640.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2999-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3197-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

856-997-4321-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-7396.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

240-1115-2511-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4556-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-4556-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3054-3416-4476-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-4476-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Answered Prayers triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

5220-5686-6537-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-4875-5703-5921.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

907-1339-1479-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
907-1339-1479-6674.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5263-5315-6243.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Ravenous Intruder abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5352-5358.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5352-5358.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {3}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5352-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

2060-3574-4029-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3574-4029-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4029-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

914-955-3335.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-955-3335.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-955-3335.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

575-2438-5971.notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2438-5971.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Carrion Feeder enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, doing nothing.
Repeat.
575-2438-5971.notes: You may instead sacrifice a different creature to get the infinite sacrifice outlet products.

338-678-2060-2606-4050.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-678-2060-2606-4050.description:
Cast Pelakka Wurm by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting seven +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm, adding {G}.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-4312-4726.notablePrerequisites:
Thallid Germinator has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-4312-4726.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Thallid Germinator.
Activate Thallid Germinator's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Thallid Germinator if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo, and you may also optionally sacrifice the Saproling tokens to Thallid Germinator's ability.

1012-1965-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Omarthis on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3079-3615-4659-4999.notablePrerequisites: You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
3079-3615-4659-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Humility removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

2816-2916-4365-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Pippin does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Pippin.
2816-2916-4365-4659.description:
Activate Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pippin by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-4053-5231.notablePrerequisites: Thermopod does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-4053-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
